disclaimer.title: Please read carefully
disclaimer.transfer: The selected documents will be uploaded to {community} as new documents submitted by you in the patient role (new identifiers). The author shown in the metadata is copied from the original document. Submission history and older versions are not carried over. After each successful upload the original in the other community is deleted immediately and irrevocably. Documents whose content already exists in {community} are skipped. Continue?
disclaimer.delete: The selected documents will be deleted in their community immediately and irrevocably. They are not copied to {community}. Continue?
disclaimer.acknowledge: I have read and understood this. There is no undo.
backup.title: Back up documents
backup.note: The files contain medical data and are saved unencrypted on this computer in Downloads/{folder}/{date}/. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
backup.includeMetadata: Include metadata JSON for each document
backup.zip: One zip instead of single files (not available yet)
progress.title: Progress
log.title: Log
error.list: The document list could not be loaded: {error}
error.unauthorized: The portal session has expired. Reload the portal page and log in again.
error.server: The server reported an error ({status}). The run was stopped.
footer.privacy: Data goes only to api-portals.cara.ch. Tokens stay in the browser and are never stored by this extension.
list.legend: Transferable: current document in a supported format (PDF or FHIR JSON). Copy exists: a document with identical content is already in {community}; only deleting the original is offered. Superseded: an older version; versions cannot be rebuilt in {community}, so only deletion or backup is offered. Unsupported: format not supported for transfer; backup is still possible.
stateHelp.transferable: Current document in a supported format. It can be copied to {community}.
stateHelp.copyExists: A document with identical content (same hash) already exists in {community}. Only deleting the original is offered.
stateHelp.superseded: Older version of a document. Versions cannot be rebuilt in {community}; only deletion or backup is offered.
stateHelp.unsupported: Format {contentType} is not supported for transfer (PDF and FHIR JSON are). Backup is possible.
login.reloadPortal: The CARA portal page does not answer the extension yet. Reload the portal page (F5) and then click “Reload” here.
compat.banner: The portal's interface no longer looks like the version this extension was verified with ({problems}). Transfer and delete are disabled; backup may still work. Please check for an updated extension.
disclaimer.safetyCopy: Save a local safety copy of each document (file + metadata JSON) in Downloads/{folder}/{date}/ before it is deleted. A document is not deleted if the copy cannot be saved.
intro.title: Before you start
intro.p1: cara-transfer is an independent tool by ahdis ag. It is not provided by, affiliated with or endorsed by CARA, phellow seven or eHealth Suisse.
intro.p2: It works inside your logged-in CARA patient portal session and uses the portal's internal interfaces, which are not a public or guaranteed API. It can stop working at any time when the portal changes.
intro.p3: Transferring or deleting documents is irreversible in the original community. Keep your own backups; the tool saves a local safety copy before every deletion unless you switch that off.
intro.p4: The software is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind, and you use it at your own risk. No data leaves your browser except to the CARA servers themselves.
